§6RBMK Fuel Types & Mechanics

§aEach fuel has a unique flux function. Pick wrong and your reactor goes critical.

§6Assembly§f: 8 billets + Empty RBMK Fuel Rod = filled rod (shapeless).

§6Key Stats§f:
§b• Yield§f, total neutron capacity (most: §e100M§f, neutron sources: §e25-50M§f)
§b• Flux Function§f, determines output from input. 8 types, ascending danger:
  Passive (constant) → Euler → Sigmoid → Logarithmic → Square Root → Negative Quadratic → Linear → Quadratic
§b• Heat Per Flux§f, °C per output flux unit
§b• Diffusion§f, core-to-skin heat transfer rate

§6Danger Tiers§f:
§aLow§f: Ra226Be, ThMEU, NU. Safe with cooling.
§eMedium§f: MEU, MOX, MEP239, LES. Needs control.
§cHigh§f: HEU233, HEP239, MES, Balefire, Digamma. Strict control required.

§6Self-Igniting§f: LEA, MEA, HEA241, LEAus, Pu238Be, Flashgold, Flashlead, Balefire, Digamma. Produce heat without external flux.

§6Decay Functions§f: Linear, Gentle Slope, Raising Slope, Boosted Slope, Static. Affect reactivity as fuel depletes.

§ePS:§f ThMEU is the safest fuel. Its Euler function physically cannot exceed 20 flux output. Great for stabilizing dangerous fuels.
